scripts.prepare: turbo run generate:templates generate:plugin-scaffold generate generate:bb-official-marketplace --filter=@kaioken/templates --filter=@kaioken/plugin-build --filter=@kaioken/server --output-logs=errors-only --summarize=false
scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-native-modules.mjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=development dotenv -c development -- node --conditions=source --import tsx packages/scripts/src/commands/run-dev.ts
scripts.start:worktree: cross-env NODE_ENV=development dotenv -c development -- node --conditions=source --import tsx packages/scripts/src/commands/run-dev.ts --worktree
scripts.dev:remote: cross-env KAIOKEN_DEV_APP_HOST=0.0.0.0 KAIOKEN_SERVER_BIND_HOST=0.0.0.0 pnpm run dev
scripts.dev:host-daemon: cross-env NODE_ENV=development dotenv -c development -- node --conditions=source --import tsx packages/scripts/src/commands/run-host-daemon.ts
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production dotenv -c production -- node --conditions=source --import tsx scripts/start-kaioken.mjs
scripts.start:host-daemon: cross-env NODE_ENV=production dotenv -c production -- pnpm run --silent kaioken-app:prepare && cross-env NODE_ENV=production dotenv -c production -- node packages/kaioken-app/dist/kaioken-app.js host-daemon
scripts.seed:perf: node scripts/ensure-native-modules.mjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=development node --conditions=source --import tsx packages/scripts/src/commands/seed-perf-db.ts
scripts.reset: cross-env NODE_ENV=production pnpm run --silent scripts:prepare && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node packages/scripts/dist/commands/reset-kaioken-data.js
scripts.reset:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development pnpm run --silent scripts:prepare && cross-env NODE_ENV=development node packages/scripts/dist/commands/reset-kaioken-data.js
scripts.reset:all: cross-env NODE_ENV=production pnpm run --silent scripts:prepare && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node packages/scripts/dist/commands/reset-kaioken-data.js --all
scripts.kaioken: cross-env NODE_ENV=production pnpm run --silent cli:prepare 1>&2 && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node packages/scripts/dist/commands/run-cli.js
